title: Hero Debug
bug_description: Page hangs / too many re-renders when Hero is shown.
root_cause: setState is called directly in the render body, causing an infinite re-render loop.
fix_explanation: Do not call setState during render. Move the increment to an event handler or useEffect with correct dependencies.
best_practices: Do not call setState directly in the component body
Use React DevTools Profiler to detect re-renders
Derived state can be computed without useState when no interaction is needed
common_mistakes: Adding conditionals without understanding the render flow
Removing state the UI still needs
learning_objective: Debug an infinite render loop in React

title: List Key Debug
bug_description: Input state inside list items resets when the list is filtered.
root_cause: Using array index as key — React reuses the wrong DOM nodes when order changes.
fix_explanation: Use a stable id from the data as the key, not the index.
best_practices: Stable keys from data (id), not index
Do not use random keys on every render
common_mistakes: Keeping index because it is easier
Using labels that can duplicate as keys
learning_objective: Understand the importance of keys on React lists
